preconditions.name: FillDB performance logging is disabled
preconditions.query: not exists value "EnablePerformanceLogging" whose (it as string = "1") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

preconditions.name: No central FillDB performance path is active
preconditions.query: not exists value "PerformanceDataPath" whose (it as string as lowercase contains "\bigfix_health_check\") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

steps.name: enable-without-auto-disable
steps.task_file: Tasks and Analyses/Individual Tasks/BigFix Master Class -- Enable FillDB Performance Logging (2.0).bes

assertions.name: FillDB performance logging is enabled
assertions.query: exists value "EnablePerformanceLogging" whose (it as string = "1") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

assertions.name: FillDB performance path uses the central folder
assertions.query: exists value "PerformanceDataPath" whose (it as string as lowercase = "c:\bigfix_health_check\platform\results\logs\filldb_performance\filldbperf.log") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

assertions.name: No performance expiration is set
assertions.query: exists values of settings "__FillDB_Perf_Logs_Expiration" of client

steps.name: manual-disable
steps.task_file: Tasks and Analyses/Individual Tasks/WARNING_ BigFix Master Class -- FillDB Performance Logging is Enabled (2.0).bes

assertions.name: FillDB performance logging is disabled
assertions.query: not exists value "EnablePerformanceLogging" whose (it as string = "1") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

assertions.name: Central performance path is no longer active
assertions.query: not exists value "PerformanceDataPath" whose (it as string as lowercase contains "\bigfix_health_check\") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

assertions.name: Performance backup marker value is removed
assertions.query: exists values of settings "__FillDB_Perf_Logs_Backup_Value" of client

assertions.name: Performance expiration marker value is removed
assertions.query: exists values of settings "__FillDB_Perf_Logs_Expiration" of client

preconditions.name: FillDB performance logging is disabled
preconditions.query: not exists value "EnablePerformanceLogging" whose (it as string = "1") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

steps.name: enable-and-auto-disable
steps.task_file: Tasks and Analyses/Individual Tasks/BigFix Master Class -- Enable FillDB Performance Logging (2.0).bes

assertions.name: Generated disable turns performance logging off
assertions.query: not exists value "EnablePerformanceLogging" whose (it as string = "1") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

assertions.name: Generated disable clears the central performance path
assertions.query: not exists value "PerformanceDataPath" whose (it as string as lowercase contains "\bigfix_health_check\") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

assertions.name: Generated disable does not restore a sentinel path
assertions.query: not exists value "PerformanceDataPath" whose (it as string as lowercase = "was not set" or it as string as lowercase = "needs to be set") of key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\BigFix\Enterprise Server\FillDB" of x32 registry

assertions.name: Generated disable removes the performance backup marker value
assertions.query: exists values of settings "__FillDB_Perf_Logs_Backup_Value" of client

assertions.name: Generated disable removes the performance expiration marker value
assertions.query: exists values of settings "__FillDB_Perf_Logs_Expiration" of client
